title: Routing evals contract
description: Realistic task prompts and the skill each should load, read by skill-maintenance's check-routing.mjs (offline ranking, or --live with Claude Code). Every authored, model-invocable skill needs at least two evals (--min-per-skill). A plain list of evals is accepted too.

prompt.description: A task as a developer would write it, without the skill's name.

expect.description: The skill folder name that should load, or null when no project skill should.
